description: Compile a build (professions, attributes, 8 skills by exact English name) into an official in-game template code. The build is validated first; on rule violations the errors are returned instead of a code. Unknown skill names return closest-match suggestions. IMPORTANT: template codes MUST come from this tool — never write or guess a code by hand, hand-written codes are invalid in-game. If unsure, verify any code with decode_template.

attributes.description: Attribute point allocations (template format caps this at 15 entries)

forHero.description: Set true if this bar is for a hero (PvE-only skills are flagged)

forPvp.description: Set true for a PvP character's bar: PvE-only skills become errors. Never use '(PvP)' skill versions, even here: templates always carry the PvE id.

secondary.description: Secondary profession, e.g. "Monk". Omit or "None" for none.

skills.description: Exactly 8 skill names in bar order. Use null for an empty slot. Names must be exact English skill names.

unlockedSkillIds.description: Optional: unlocked skill ids from a GWToolbox account export (/exportaccount). Skills outside this list are flagged as warnings.

name: encode_template

code.description: Official in-game template code (present on success)

errors.description: Present (non-empty) when resolution failed or the build is invalid

valid.description: false when the build resolved but is illegal; absent on the other two shapes

title: Encode a build into a template code
